title: Build the csvcast CSV-to-JSON-Lines converter from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the csvcast CLI exactly as written in assets/gc-397/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-397/csvcast.py. The spec fixes an ordered type-inference ladder (with deliberately strict integer/float regexes), header deduplication, ragged-row padding, and a --strict abort protocol. Decompose the spec into testable behaviors, implement, run the sealed suite, and iterate on the divergences it exposes (inference order and ragged-row semantics are the usual failure points) until fully green.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-397/plan.md exists before implementation, listing the inference ladder and ragged-row cases as separate work items.
The sealed suite was executed at least twice with outputs logged to workspace/gc-397/runs.log (intermediate RED runs allowed, final GREEN required).
Intermediate failures recorded by test node id with the corresponding code change, not just pass/fail counts.
Honest cost logging: LLM spend per iteration recorded in workspace/gc-397/cost.json.
Recovery after RED is visible in the log as diagnosis -> fix -> re-run, with no edits to assets/gc-397/test_accept.py.
